current_evidence: The council's Local Validation page states the list was adopted by Strategic Planning Committee on 8 April 2024 and came into effect on 1 May 2024. The 'East Suffolk Local Validation List 2024' PDF repeats these dates and carries a 10 July 2025 amendment note (Certificate A text deleted), so no later list was adopted.

issues.detail: The 'Validation list URL' points to Chapter 6 of the Local Validation Guidance, a single application-type chapter, not to the Local Validation List. The list itself (sections 2.2-2.72) is a separate document that Grokbot also read (the 2025-10 'Local Validation List.pdf'), so it should be the headline link. Neither /sites/default/files/ URL could be fetched in this check (client error); the list fetched fine from the /assets/ path.
issues.evidence: Local Validation Guidance page: 'divided into chapters, each for a different application type' and it 'sits alongside the Local Validation List'

issues.detail: List date 2025-12-01 is the upload month of the guidance chapter. The list was adopted on 8 April 2024 and took effect on 1 May 2024; the only later change is a 10 July 2025 amendment to the ownership certificate text.
issues.evidence: 'Agreed for adoption 8 April 2024 ... came into effect 1 May 2024'; '2.5.7 ... deleted on 10 July 2025'

issues.detail: These numbered local requirements do not appear anywhere in Grokbot's tab_items or app_type_rows: 2.2 Agricultural Diversification Statement (farm/rural diversification; recommended); 2.4 Amendments/Changes Statement (s73, non-material amendments, reserved matters on live schemes); 2.12 Building Heights/Number of Storeys Plan (major/minor schemes with varying heights); 2.26 Dust Assessment; 2.27 Dwelling Sizes and Tenure Plan (residential schemes over two dwellings); 2.36 Geodiversity Survey; 2.37 Glint and Glare Assessment; 2.42 Hydrographical/Bathymetric Survey (works below high tide level); 2.43 Isometric Drawings/Virtual 3D Modelling; 2.44 Joinery and Window Details; 2.56 Public Rights of Way; 2.65 Sustainable Construction Statement; 2.66 Telecommunications Report; 2.67 Topographical Survey (significant level changes).
issues.evidence: ESC Local Validation List 2024, section headings 2.2-2.72

issues.detail: Several requirements are mentioned only inside policy text in tab_items and have no requirement row of their own: 2.10 Biomass Boiler Form (new or replacement biomass boilers); 2.13 Coastal Erosion Vulnerability Assessment (development in a Coastal Change Management Area or within 30m landward of it); 2.51 Odour Assessment; 2.19 Conversion Specification (appears only as a fragment in the prior approval Roof plan/Structural Survey excerpt).
issues.evidence: 2.13: 'Development in a Coastal Change Management Area, or within or 30m landward of it'

issues.detail: The Householder row 'Archaeological Assessment' uses an excerpt that excludes householders ('application is a Major or Minor (i.e. not householder...'). The same excerpt is reused for Change of use - prior approval. Householder also lacks the Arboricultural Assessment and Tree Survey (2.6), Heritage Statement (2.40) and Flood Risk Assessment (2.32), which the list applies by location or trees whatever the application type.
issues.evidence: Grokbot's excerpt: 'An Archaeological Assessment will be required. application is a 'Major' or 'Minor' (i.e. not householder...'

issues.detail: Rows with no basis in the source. Viability Assessment is listed under Advertisement consent, Non-material amendment and prior approval with the excerpt 'form of Viability Assessments.'. 'Pre-application advice' under Advertisement consent is advice, not a requirement. Electric vehicle charging under s73 quotes text about listed buildings. Ecological Survey under Listed building consent uses a generic list of constraints.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows: Advertisement consent | Viability Assessment | 'form of Viability Assessments.'

issues.detail: About 50 requirements are placed under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named', although the list gives thresholds. Examples: Air Quality (usually Major), Community Consultation Statement (all Majors only), Health Impact Assessment and Retail Impact (thresholds). 'Schedule of works (listed building)' sits under Full planning, but its excerpt is about an Arboricultural Method Statement.
issues.evidence: 2.14 'Required for all Major developments'; Schedule of works excerpt 'An Arboricultural Method Statement should also be provided...'

issues.detail: Many excerpts are fragments that leave out the trigger. Examples: Affordable Housing ('by and Affordable Housing Statement.'); Cycle parking ('space for cycle parking. 2.34.4.'); Photographs ('scale, not photographed.', reused under five application types); Planning Obligations ('Webpage Draft Heads of Terms requirements in the Local Validation List Drainage'); Structural Survey ('...Ecological Surveys and Assessments The regulations also specify...'); Health Impact Assessment ('for all applications which include: o o o o o').

Most of the 118 tab_items are guidance prose rather than requirements. They include redaction advice and personal statements, the planning@eastsuffolk.gov.uk / Riverside postal address, 'We will endeavour to notify you within five working days', file links ('CL-Advice-Note-1.pdf (eastsuffolk.gov.uk)', 'Settlement-Fringe-Landscape-Sensitivity-Study.pdf'), navigation text ('Validation Webpage Local Validation List Local Validation Guidance...') and bare lists of designations ('Special Protection Areas (SPA)').

The tab_items repeat the same text several times: the sewage treatment plant 'volume/capacity, outflow quality, outflow rates' text appears at least twice, and the SPA/SAC/Ramsar designation lists and RAMS 13km sentences three or four times.
issues.evidence: tab_items: '- its volume/capacity, outflow quality, outflow rates...' (repeated)

issues.detail: The validation page requires compliance with the council's Artificial Intelligence Policy, including declaring any use of AI in submitted materials (paragraph 6.9). Grokbot did not record this.
issues.evidence: Local Validation page: applications must comply with the East Suffolk Council Artificial Intelligence Policy ... paragraph 6.9

summary: Grokbot's headline link and date belong to one guidance chapter uploaded in December 2025, not to the Local Validation List, which was adopted 8 April 2024 and effective 1 May 2024. The extraction has many fragmentary triggers and misplaced application types, and about 14 numbered local requirements are absent, including Glint and Glare, Telecommunications, Topographical Survey and Rights of Way.
